closed_findings.call_helper: Before iterating actual arguments, profiles with more than two callable roles prepay (arguments.len()+1)*signature.callable.len(). Every argument's ordered bound search costs at most the complete role count; the extra role-count allowance covers the additional owned-State lookup. This uses the existing live closures::State balance.
closed_findings.forwarded_contract: Before growing the role mapping and iterating actual environment arguments, a child with more than two roles prepays arguments.len()*role_count. This bounds the complete child-role search for each actual position; the existing mapping, argument scan and concrete-set construction charges remain.
closed_findings.all_child_events: At each static child call, before cloning child traces or running retain/substitute, final b304 computes child_roles=R+C and prepays addition.calls*(R+C) when child_roles>2. R is the symbolic mapping length and C the concrete-role set length. Each original event can require at most C concrete key comparisons plus R ordered mapping comparisons. Counts are taken before filtering, so removed events are paid too. child_size sums all calls in every Finite path and every Flow node, including trapping/inactive paths retained by this representation; both trace forms pass through the same reservation.
closed_findings.review_followup: The intermediate 75ec predicate R>2 did not cover repeated concrete-set probes when R<=2 and C>2. Reviewer identified this during delta review; author confirmed and fixed it in b304 with the R+C bound. The old NotReady history is retained rather than rewriting it as if the first fix covered this case.
closed_findings.overflow: saturating_add/mul cannot wrap a large charge down. Each multiplication is reached after an existing strictly positive reservation, so the current balance is strictly less than usize::MAX even when the selected initial quota equals usize::MAX. A saturated charge therefore fails State::snapshot's checked_sub with ResourceLimit before the scans/clones. Zero-event children perform zero event searches and correctly add zero event work.
closed_findings.old_fees: The first two new reservations run only above two declared callable roles; event work runs only above two total child roles, counting symbolic and concrete roles. The entire former one/two-role profile therefore retains its existing fees. No default limit, role, origin, mode, effect, ABI or schema rule changes.
